title: Switch
description: Compares a value with a list of cases and continues along the output port of the first match, or the default port when nothing matches.

value.title: Value
value.description: Value to match. Matching is an exact text comparison (case- and whitespace-sensitive). Numbers are compared as text without a trailing ".0" (2.0 matches case 2); booleans as true or false.

cases.title: Cases
cases.description: Case values (1 to 20, unique, at most 64 characters). Each case is an output port; the default port is used when no case matches.
